risks.risk: Starter motor may not be included (photo doesn’t clearly show it). This affects value because starter motors are typically separately priced vs scrap metal.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the starter motor showing the body, electrical terminals, and any label/part number (or a photo of all items laid out with the starter clearly visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a bundle of drive shafts + steering rack + radiator/condenser only (starter excluded).

risks.risk: Total weight may be overstated or not match what you receive; pricing for scrap bundles depends heavily on actual kg.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video of the certified scale reading with the full bundle on it, plus the weighing slip.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst case for weight uncertainty (treat as not guaranteed to be 500 kg).

risks.risk: Parts may be heavily damaged (bent shafts, cracked radiator core, missing components). Photo shows general presence but not internal damage or completeness.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of: (1) shaft ends/splines, (2) rubber boot condition and any leaks/tears, (3) steering rack mounting points, (4) radiator core for bent fins/leaks (and a quick water/air test video if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/for scrap only (no working/repairable assumption).

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch (seller says “two drive shafts” but only one photo is provided; could be fewer/more).
risks.proof: Ask for a top-down layout photo showing each item counted (two shafts, steering rack, radiator/condenser, and starter if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the minimum confirmed quantities from the photo.

proof_requests: Close-up photo(s) clearly showing the starter motor (if included): body + electrical terminals + any markings.
Photo/video of the certified scale reading the full bundle, plus the weighing slip.
Top-down layout photo showing all items counted (two drive shafts, steering rack/gear, radiator/condenser, starter).
Close-ups of shaft ends/splines and radiator core (bent fins/cracks/leaks) to confirm damage level.
response.reason: The photo supports that drive-shaft-like parts, a steering rack/gear-like unit, and a radiator/condenser are present, but the starter motor and the claimed 500 kg certified weight are not verifiable from the single image. Without proof, the correct worst-case pricing cannot be set confidently.
